# Review — kebra-nagast-ch113-115

No modern translations opened; Dillmann unavailable, so uncertain calls are hedged with (?). The house glossaries of published parts (ch. 2–8, 17–20, 25–26, 49–50, 60a, 67, 97, 102, 108, 111, 112) were used as the comparison. `t` is unchanged in every unit (checked against the original). All 153 gloss entries and the one `__broaden__` entry were checked.

## Findings refused (kept as drafted)

- Unit 0 / glosses መግረሬ, ወመግረሬ: lemma መግረሪ and "instrument noun" kept; hedged (?) already, cannot be bettered without Dillmann.
- Unit 12 ይትሀወክ "thrown into confusion": kept; within the range of "shaken, troubled".
- Unit 13 note on Gregory the Illuminator's pit: kept; it is flagged as an analogy and the text says only "Gregory".
- Unit 17 i "means": kept; it makes the topic construction (ዘንተ ዘይቤ) readable and does not change the sense.
- Unit 21 i "two or three": kept; the `__broaden__` entry for ወ፫ already records ወ as "or" and the note gives the literal "two and three".
- Unit 21 ጠል/ዘእምኀቤከ, unit 22 l "the-earth": acceptable; not changed.
- Glosses ወየኀብር (ኀብረ), ገብረ, ወይገፈትእዋ (ገፍትአ), መዛግሒሃ (መዝጋሕ), ተኀበለ, ተሀየደ/ሀየደ, ይትዐረቅ: vowel/spelling of the dictionary form cannot be checked without Dillmann; ኀብረ and ሀየደ agree with the house glossary (ch. 1, 24); the others are already marked (?). Left.
- Gloss ሀየደ meaning: house ch. 24 has "plunder, carry off"; "remove, take away" is compatible in these contexts, so not broadened.
- Gloss ወእምግብርናተ (ግብርና (?)): agrees with the house entry (ch. 67, 80). Kept.
- Gloss ወሕንጽታ (ሕንጽት (?)): ch. 9–12 has ሕንጽት as a passive participle under ሐነጸ; the noun reading is hedged (?) in the unit and the gloss. Kept.
- Gloss ሰማልያል, ቅንዋት, ማእዜኑ, ዘንተኬ and the numeral entries (፻፲፫, ፻፲፬, ፻፲፭): checked, correct as spoken forms and parses.

## Remaining (?) cruxes

መግረሬ (curb, root unknown); ባውስተ/ውስ ተ (printed slips); ግዕዞሙ (freedom or tongue); አትከሉ ርእሶሙ (Sodom comparison); ወመሠጥ; ይትዐረቅ አማዑቲሆሙ (poured out vs reconciled); ይትኤዝዝ (commanded vs obey); ይከብቶ (surround vs seize); ዘትጸንን and ትሄሉ in unit 15; ውሕኮ; ሰማልያል; መዛግሒሃ; ወሕንጽታ; ቀፈላ; ወሪድየ; ግሙራ; ፼ ዓመት (10,000 vs 1,000); ቅስተ (chastisement vs bow).
